thread:
maria: 48h out reminder — quick release checkpoint. Is the version bump PR merged into release/v2.5, changelog consolidated, and CI stable? Any outstanding blockers?

jason: PR #2304 (release branch) is merged but I forgot the package.json version bump. I can open a tiny PR to patch it. not a blocker but want to call it out.

anya: I can do the changelog consolidation this afternoon. Can someone drop the list of merged PRs that need special notes (breaking changes, migrations)?

maria: thanks. items to highlight: #2289 (config API rename), #2293 (embedding cache behavior change — perf note), #2301 (deployment rollback fix). Those cover the notable user-facing things.

ci-bot: buildkite/ci-pipeline: build 9876 finished — 2 failing tests on linux/amd64 and mac-12: tests/integration/streaming-cache.test.js (flake) and e2e/auth.login.spec.js (consistently failing on mac).

kevin: I'm on flakes. I'll re-run the failing jobs and triage root cause. tagging @qa-ops for the mac e2e failure.

qa-ops: noted. grabbing logs now. mac failure looks like a timing assertion in the login flow — might be an environment flake from our mock auth service.

kevin: reran pipeline: linux job passed after rerun, mac e2e still failing consistently. Will try isolating the test locally.

jason: if we can't get mac green before cutoff, do we have a policy? last release we allowed mac e2e to be excluded with an explicit note in the changelog and a follow-up rollback window.

maria: policy reminder — for patch releases we can proceed if only non-critical CI lab flakes remain and we open tickets to follow up. For minor/major we prefer all green unless the failure is infra and reproducible locally. This is a minor release (2.5.0) so aim for green but we have the option to gate if it looks systemic.

anya: I'll prepare the changelog entry and flag the auth e2e in the notes if unresolved. Can someone confirm the final semver we want? 2.5.0?

jason: yes 2.5.0. I'll open the version bump PR now. Command I run:

```
# from release/v2.5
yarn version --new-version 2.5.0
git commit -am "chore(release): bump v2.5.0"
git push origin HEAD:release/v2.5
```

maria: thanks. once that's up, @kevin please add a CI rerun and post the build link here.

kevin: version bump PR opened: #2310. Triggered a full pipeline run: buildkite/ci-pipeline#9880. link: https://buildkite.example/9880

ci-bot: buildkite/ci-pipeline#9880: linux ✅, windows ✅, mac ❌ (e2e/auth.login.spec.js failed) — logs: https://buildkite.example/9880/logs/456

kevin: dug into logs — mock auth sometimes returns 503 on mac workers during setup, causing the login flow to time out. Filing infra ticket and retrying pinned worker: INFRA-571.

qa-ops: submitted INFRA-571 and added retry policy to the mac e2e step for this pipeline. Rerun triggered.

ci-bot: rerun buildkite/ci-pipeline#9880 (retry): mac ✅ — all checks green now.

maria: great. changelog ready? anya?

anya: changelog consolidated and pushed to #2310 (PR body). I added a short note about the auth e2e flake and linked INFRA-571. Also added migration notes for #2289.

maria: ok final checklist: version bump PR merged, changelog in PR body, CI passing, release notes reviewed. Does anyone object to proceeding with the release window tomorrow at T-48h? 

jason: no objections from me.

kevin: 👍 no objections.

qa-ops: good to go from QA side.

maria: perfect — I'll schedule the release job and post ETA in #release-announcements. If anything pops up overnight, ping here and we'll triage async. :party_parrot:
